## ExecutionRequest.resourcePlans property

The value plans of the app's resources, from its registered contract: what converting a reference in `input` or in the result needs. Always present: an app registered without a contract passes `EMPTY_RESOURCE_PLAN_TABLE`<!-- -->, and then no reference converts.

**Signature:**

```typescript
readonly resourcePlans: ResourcePlanTable;
```
